formal_comm_plan: Run CellChat/LIANA for MIF-CD74 edges and NicheNet targets in immune_myeloid/synovial fibroblast response states.
synovial_fluid_targets: MIF, soluble CD74 if available, macrophage chemokines
in_vitro_model: senescent meniscus conditioned medium -> synovial fibroblasts, macrophage-like cells, or chondrocytes
perturbation_strategy: anti-MIF or ISO-1; CD74 blockade as a receptor-side sensitivity test
primary_readouts: IL6, CXCL8, MMP3, MMP13, NF-kB/STAT3 targets, senescence/SASP markers
risk_note: CD74 is strongest in immune cells; tissue contamination and immune-cell abundance must be separated from paracrine activation.

formal_comm_plan: Prioritize CellChat/LIANA integrin-family consensus; use NicheNet cautiously because integrin target priors are incomplete.
synovial_fluid_targets: ANGPTL4 plus matrix-remodeling proteins and integrin-associated ECM fragments
in_vitro_model: senescent meniscus conditioned medium -> endothelial cells, synovial fibroblasts, and chondrocytes
perturbation_strategy: anti-ANGPTL4, ITGB1 blocking antibody, ITGAV blocking antibody, or RGD/integrin competition control
primary_readouts: tube formation, endothelial migration, COL1A1/COL3A1/FN1, MMPs, cell adhesion, ECM remodeling
risk_note: Integrin axes are matrix-context dependent; soluble LR inference alone is weaker than functional adhesion/angiogenesis evidence.

formal_comm_plan: Run CellChat/LIANA VEGF signaling and confirm endothelial receptor-state localization.
synovial_fluid_targets: VEGFA, soluble FLT1 if available, angiogenesis panel proteins
in_vitro_model: senescent meniscus conditioned medium -> endothelial tube formation and synovial fibroblast activation
perturbation_strategy: anti-VEGFA or VEGFR inhibitor; include endothelial viability control
primary_readouts: tube formation, endothelial migration, KDR/FLT1 targets, ANGPT2, IL6, MMPs
risk_note: VEGF is biologically strong but not meniscus-specific; tie it back to MSP-high cell states and joint-fluid protein evidence.

formal_comm_plan: Use CellChat/LIANA chemokine signaling calls and NicheNet target overlap with S1-high inflammatory genes.
synovial_fluid_targets: MIF, CXCL12, CCL2, CXCL8 and matched chemokine panel proteins
in_vitro_model: senescent meniscus conditioned medium -> synovial fibroblasts or immune-cell migration assay
perturbation_strategy: CXCR4 antagonist AMD3100, CXCR2 antagonist, CCR2 antagonist, or ligand-neutralizing antibody matched to the axis
primary_readouts: cell migration, IL6/CXCL8/CCL2 secretion, NF-kB targets, macrophage activation markers
risk_note: Chemokine receptors can be sparse in dissociated single-cell data; use protein and functional migration evidence before strong claims.

formal_comm_plan: Use LIANA plus NicheNet target prediction for activin/TGF-beta-family remodeling targets.
synovial_fluid_targets: INHBA/activin A and TGF-beta-family panel proteins
in_vitro_model: senescent meniscus conditioned medium -> chondrocytes and synovial fibroblasts
perturbation_strategy: follistatin, activin receptor blockade, or ALK4/5/7 pathway inhibitor with toxicity control
primary_readouts: SMAD2/3 targets, COL1A1, COL2A1, ACAN, MMP13, ADAMTS5, fibrotic markers
risk_note: Single-cell receptor context is sparse for several ACVR receptors; require pathway readout before prioritizing mechanistic claims.

formal_comm_plan: Use LIANA/NicheNet BMP target overlap with fibrocartilage differentiation and hypertrophic remodeling genes.
synovial_fluid_targets: BMP2 and BMP pathway proteins if available
in_vitro_model: meniscus fibrochondrocyte/chondrocyte response to senescent conditioned medium
perturbation_strategy: noggin or BMP receptor inhibitor such as LDN-193189
primary_readouts: ID1/ID2, RUNX2, COL10A1, ACAN, COL2A1, MMP13, fibrocartilage differentiation markers
risk_note: BMP signals can be repair-associated or degenerative depending on context; interpret direction with differentiation readouts.

formal_comm_plan: Run LIANA/NicheNet FGF target checks in fibrochondrocyte and outer-fibrous states.
in_vitro_model: senescent meniscus conditioned medium -> meniscal fibrochondrocytes and synovial fibroblasts
perturbation_strategy: FGFR inhibitor such as BGJ398 or PD173074 with viability control
primary_readouts: ERK targets, proliferation, COL1A1/FN1, MMPs, PRG4, catabolic markers
risk_note: FGF biology is pleiotropic; distinguish repair/proliferation from inflammatory remodeling.

formal_comm_plan: Run LIANA and NicheNet for IL11-gp130 target genes, especially fibroblast activation modules.
synovial_fluid_targets: IL11, soluble IL11RA if available, gp130-family cytokine panel
in_vitro_model: senescent meniscus conditioned medium -> synovial fibroblasts and chondrocytes
perturbation_strategy: anti-IL11, anti-IL11RA, or JAK/STAT pathway blockade
primary_readouts: STAT3/ERK targets, COL1A1, ACTA2, FN1, IL6, MMP3, MMP13
risk_note: IL11RA detection is modest; use pathway activation and blockade rescue as the deciding evidence.

formal_comm_plan: Use CellChat/LIANA and NicheNet for IL6-gp130 inflammatory target programs.
in_vitro_model: senescent meniscus conditioned medium -> synovial fibroblasts and chondrocytes
perturbation_strategy: JAK inhibitor, gp130 pathway blockade, or ligand/receptor-specific antibody if available
primary_readouts: STAT3 phosphorylation/targets, IL6, CXCL8, MMP3, MMP13, senescence/SASP markers
risk_note: Generic inflammatory signaling can dilute MSP specificity; require co-localization with MSP-high states or subtype-specific evidence.

formal_comm_plan: Run CellChat/LIANA SPP1-CD44/integrin calls and NicheNet matrix-inflammatory target overlap.
in_vitro_model: senescent meniscus conditioned medium -> synovial fibroblasts, macrophage-like cells, and chondrocytes
perturbation_strategy: anti-SPP1, CD44 blockade, or integrin blockade matched to receptor context
primary_readouts: macrophage/fibroblast activation, CD44 targets, MMPs, COL1A1/FN1, inflammatory cytokines
risk_note: SPP1 is strong in OA literature but was not a primary cNMF MSP ligand in this pipeline; keep it as validation-rich second tier.

formal_comm_plan: Use LIANA integrin-family consensus and matrix target enrichment rather than relying on one LR database.
